identification: Single-sided flat green sign with cream/yellow serif capitals 'BP / AUSTRALIA / LTD.' and a much smaller, heavily worn white line at the bottom that reads as 'INCORPORATED IN VICTORIA'. 54 x 39 cm (catalogue; looks squarish in photos), rounded corners, four fixing holes. This is a company name plate for a BP Australia Ltd office, depot or terminal, not a forecourt brand sign (no shield logo). BP Australia Ltd took that name in 1957 (formerly Commonwealth Oil Refineries) and was incorporated in Victoria, so the sign is 1957 or later, probably 1957 to 1970s. Condition: face is clean with good colour; small chip/rust at top left hole and a few specks; the bottom 'Incorporated in Victoria' line is almost entirely worn away; back (photo 4) is black with rust spotting.

viewing_check: Confirm vitreous enamel: glassy hard surface, chips show grey/black steel and layered enamel at the edges, back counter-enamelled. A painted sign shows brush marks and paint flaking rather than conchoidal chips. Check for a maker's name on the bottom edge and the condition of the four holes.
